options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Required Route
options.doc:
Main route of the game required to win.
normal_ending: Awaken all 4 elementals to open the Sanctum, then get all 4 Sanctum Hits to reach the end of Sanctum
secret_ending: Reach the end of Sanctum with all 120 Star Pieces in your possession
mysterious_ending: Reach the end of Sanctum with all 120 Star Pieces and 30 Pyramidions in your possession.
all_gems: Gather 12 of each gem type and all 14-18 obsidian.

options.name: Star Pieces Required
options.doc: How many Star Pieces are needed to get the secret and mysterious ending

options.name: Required Pyramidions
options.doc: How many Pyramidions are required to get the mysterious ending

options.name: Shuffle Gems
options.doc: If enabled, gems can be found anywhere instead of their vanilla locations.

options.name: Shuffle Music Notes
options.doc: Turn all music notes in the game into location checks. Music puzzles will be filled progressively from stoney cliffs to frozen spire.

options.name: Shuffle Elemental Quests
options.doc: If enabled, completing a god's quests will grant a random item, and awakening the elementals will be shuffled into the item pool.

options.name: Shuffle Big Bell Hits
options.doc:
If enabled, hitting a Big Bell will grant a random item, and the bell hits will be shuffled into the item pool.
You still need all 4 bell hits to break the Beast Bell Stone.

options.name: Shuffle Sanctum Shards Hit
options.doc:
If enabled, hitting the shards in Sanctum will grant a random item, and the shard hits will be shuffled into the item pool.
You need all 4 shard hits to reach the end of Sanctum.

options.name: Shuffle Pyramidions
options.doc:
If enabled, Pyramidions and other Serpent Circlet puzzle rewards will be shuffled into the item pool.
Adds 8 serpent lock shards, 1 serpent circlet, 30 pyramidions, 4 obsidian and 1 ancient key.
The 4 Obsidian locations will not be randomized if shuffle gems is disabled.

options.name: Shuffle Meteorites (Experimental)
options.doc:
[EXPERIMENTAL]
If enabled, 5 meteorites and 8 warp portal patterns will be shuffled into the item pool
The meteorite location at Lost Lagoon will not be included if the serpent circlet it not in the pool.

options.name: Enable Snakesanity
options.doc: Turn all snake blocks in the game into location checks. (Snake block = Green directional block with an arrowhead on top)

options.name: Serpent Puzzle Memorization
options.doc:
If enabled, you will be expected to be able to solve serpent puzzles and shoal pattern puzzles by memory.
Logic will no longer consider whether you can reach the puzzle's serpent clue.
Exceptions are the shoal puzzles in A0 and A1, which are random per save file.
This option does nothing if serpent circlet content is not enabled.

options.name: Warps In Logic
options.doc:
If enabled, you may be expected to use warps and other meteor quest mechanics to reach Star Tropic and Forgotten Lagoon.
If Shuffle Meteorites is enabled then this is forced on.

options.name: Summon Phoenix Anywhere
options.doc: You can summon the Phoenix in any non-overworld location by pressing: 'E', if you have the Phoenix Flute.

options.name: Filler Composition
options.doc:
Determines what items are sent as Filler, allowing you to make faster progress depending on the option selected.
Default: only allows Seashells as filler.
Extra Goodies: adds Ancient Keys, Star Pieces, and Gems to the filler pool.
Only Goodies: replaces the entire filler pool with Ancient Keys, Star Pieces and Gems.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc: Determines the amount of deaths you must have before a deathlink is sent to the server.

options.name: Traps (Experimental)
options.doc:
[EXPERIMENTAL]
When enabled, transforms filler items into traps instead.
